instruction: Please help me install the GitLens extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the GitLens extension (eamodio.gitlens) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Command structure will fail at runtime: command passed as list ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'eamodio.gitlens'] without shell=True, causing pipe operator to be treated as literal argument instead of shell operator
The get_vm_command_line getter defaults to shell=False, so the pipe and grep will not execute correctly
Metric logic (is_extension_installed with 'contain' rule) is semantically correct for checking extension presence
Expected value 'eamodio.gitlens' is correct for GitLens extension
Alternative correct approaches: (1) use shell=True in config, (2) pass as single string, or (3) use only 'code --list-extensions' without grep since metric does 'contain' check anyway
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'shell': true to the evaluator.result.command config to enable shell mode for pipe operator
OR change command to single string format if shell mode is enabled
OR simplify to just ['code', '--list-extensions'] without pipe/grep, since the is_extension_installed metric already does a 'contain' check on the output
